create_JSONLIterator: create a JSONLIterator to iterate over a JSONL file with distributed world rank and size support
create_JSONLDirectoryIterator: create a JSONLDirectoryIterator to iterate over multiple chunked JSONL files in a directory
create_IterativeJSONLDataset: create an IterativeJSONLDataset PyTorch IterableDataset that wraps a JSONL file or directory for distributed training
create_DatasetMixer: create a DatasetMixer to sample from multiple JSONL datasets with weighted probabilities and preprocessors
create_PersistentDataLoader: create a PersistentDataLoader that wraps a StatefulDataLoader with automatic state recovery on worker failure
